abstract: In this paper, a 1.5GHz PSFTS (phase stabilized frequency transmission system) based on optical fiber link is described. Through this system, phase calibration can be realized. The principle of PSFTS is analyzed first. And then PSFTS's performance is tested in the laboratory in high and low temperature box. Also the system's performance is measured through buried fiber link. Results show that the real-time compensation mode can improve the phase stability more than 130 times in comparison with the uncompensated mode. In order to solve problems of deterioration of frequency stability and phase noise, a high stability crystal vibration phase lock module is also introduced into this system. Through multiple sets of test data, the frequency stability and phase noise has got obvious improvement. This system will be applied to TMRT (Shanghai TianMa 65 meters radio telescope) system for high precision of astronomical observations.

articleTitle: Towards secure communication via a wireless-powered full-duplex jammer
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper explores the use of a full-duplex (FD) friendly jammer to secure the communication between a transmitter and a receiver in the presence of a passive eavesdropper. The friendly jammer is considered as a wireless-powered node without embedded power supply but can harvest energy from radio frequency (RF) signals, accumulate it in the storage, and use the harvested energy to perform the cooperative jamming (CJ). A novel CJ protocol termed accumulate-and-jam (AnJ) is proposed to improve the jammer efficiency, which splits the transmission blocks into dedicated energy harvesting (DEH) blocks and opportunistic energy harvesting (OEH) blocks. In DEH blocks, the transmitter transfers wireless power to replenish the jammer. In OEH blocks, the transmitter sends information to the receiver. Using the accumulated energy, the jammer transmits jamming signals to confound the eavesdropper. Mean-while, thanks to the FD capability, the jammer can continue to harvest energy from the signals overheard from the transmitter. Compared with the existing protocols using a wireless powered half-duplex (HD) jammer, the proposed design possesses the advantage of uninterrupted energy harvesting at the jammer. A closed-form expression for the secrecy outage probability of the considered system is derived. Numerical results show that our proposed AnJ protocol can significantly outperform its HD counterpart in terms of secrecy outage probability.

articleTitle: Single-layer bandpass frequency selective structure with very wide upper stopband
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: In this paper, a single-layer bandpass frequency selective structure (FSS) of high selective performance is presented. The proposed structure consists of an array of single-layer printed circuit boards with lumped inductors, which can construct “dual-mode” stepped-impedance resonators. The operating principle is briefly explained by an equivalent circuit model and is verified by parametric studies. Simulation results indicate that the FSS features miniaturized unit cell size, very wide upper stopband, and stable frequency filtering response under a large variation of incident angles.

articleTitle: Investigation of dual-polarized ultra-wideband antenna with directional patterns
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: The design and study of multi-port single and dual-polarized ultra-wideband (UWB) antennas has been investigated in this paper. Each UWB element consists of a slotted ground plane which is fed by a L-shaped stepped microstrip line to achieve a wide bandwidth. A dumbbell-shaped slot is embedded in the ground plane to improve the impedance matching across the wide frequency range. To achieve dual orthogonal polarizations, a dual-element structure has been employed by rotating one element 90 degrees. Moreover, the four-port dual-polarized UWB antenna has been obtained by adding another two elements which enables symmetrical radiation patterns. A compact cavity has been utilized to reduce the backward radiation and enhance the front-to-back ratio (FBR). The results have confirmed that, the obtained antennas can achieve a wide frequency band from 3 to over 10 GHz.

articleTitle: A novel lowpass filter based on multistage defected ground structure
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: A lowpass filter with multistage defected ground structure is proposed. It provides better passband characteristics and sharp band-gap compared to common dumb-bell DGS. Optimization methods for DGS and microstrip line are presented based on analyzing the effects of proposed DGS dimensions on transmission characteristics and building equivalent LC circuit models. Measured results show that this filter can realize good pass under 5.4GHz with suppression over 20dB in stop band and a band-gap less than 0.6G Hz.

articleTitle: Analysis and design of a high gain and low side-lobe conformai waveguide slots array antenna
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: Compared with traditional slotted waveguide array, the paper designs a new type of conformal waveguide slot array antenna, which shape is similar to the ladder. The coupling slots control the strength of excitation and compensate the phase difference due to the different location of waveguide. The maximum gain obtains 29.2dB and low side-lobe is suppressed below 19.0dB in the array. The single-layer conformal waveguide slot array is characterized by simpler configuration, smaller longitudinal dimension and lower processing cost. The results of the simulation validate the correctness of this design approach.

articleTitle: Design of an improved high-gain omnidirectional printed dipole antenna
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This letter proposes broadband hign-gain omnidirectional printed dipole antenna unit, and a 1×2 array is designed and fabricated. The radiator of the antenna is a structure of half-wavelength dipole resonant. The antenna array is fed by a phase-shifting microstrip power divider network which is designed conformally with the middle ground. As we know, microstrip feeding is unbalanced, a metal shielding sleeve is introduced to achieve balanced feeding of the dipole. And the metal shielding sleeve also have a function of improving the operating bandwidth of the antenna, and stabilizing the structure. The measured 10dB return loss bandwidth is about 36% (1 GHz ~ 1.45 GHz), and the gain of the array is greater than 4.7dBi, and the out-of-roundness is less than 2.1 dB over the entire band.

articleTitle: Design of long range RFID tag in X-band based on modulated scattering technique
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: A novel design of a long range semi-active radio frequency identifier (RFID) tag based on the modulated scattering technique (MST) is presented in this paper. The tag system works at 9.75 GHz and achieves a reading distance about 10 m in a transmitted power of 200 mW. The tag chip obtains the temperature data from the sensor and scatters them to the reader. The communication between the reader and the tag is accorded with EM4102 RFID protocol, and the data are modulated by a diode switch circuit. The tag prototype has been designed, fabricated, and experimentally evaluated. The achieved results can provide reference for the design of high frequency RFID tags.

articleTitle: An experimental correction model for UWB through-the-wall distance measurements
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper presents error analysis and error correction for UWB signal based ranging using P410 RCMs (PulsON 410 Ranging and Communication Modules). We propose a theoretical model for precise ranging in complex indoor environments. The model intends to correct the range error incurred by rich multipath propagation and signal penetration through walls. The experimental results show that through the model based error correction, the distance measurement accuracy can be improved significantly.

articleTitle: Dual-polarized UWB antenna with unidirectional radiation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: In this paper, we present the design of a new ultra-wideband (UWB) frequency selective surface (FSS) based dual-polarized antenna, by using an FSS with sub-wavelength unit cells as a backing reflector for a UWB dual-polarized antenna. The studies of the behavior of the proposed antenna reveal that a dual-polarization over the entire UWB band with high polarization purity and a unidirectional radiation with a quasi-constant gain of an average of 9 dBi and a compact profile of λ/10 are achieved. The features of the proposed antenna make it a good candidate for integration with low profile broadband printed circuits and UWB diversity applications.

articleTitle: The RFID mutual authentication scheme based on ECC and OTP authentication
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: In the RFID environment with limited storage and computing resources, it is necessary to adopt appropriate and effective lightweight authentication technologies to ensure the security of RFID operating environment. After studying existing RFID authentication scheme and analyzing its security, a mutual authentication scheme based on ECC and OTP authentication is proposed. In this scheme, authentication information introduces a random number and a time stamp based on the traditional OTP authentication, and ECC is used to encrypt the authentication process for the its information confidentiality. The safety analysis shows that it meets basic security requirements and resists tracking, replaying, counterfeiting and other kinds of attacks. At the same time, it achieves mutual authentication between the tags and the database sides, which improves the security of RFID environment well.

articleTitle: Experimental comparison study of UWB technologies for static human detection
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper compares two dominant Ultra Wide Band(UWB) radar technologies Impulse and M-sequence for static human being detection in free space. The hardware and software platform for each system is described separately. These two radar platform performances are tested in real conditions and the results show that M-sequence UWB radar is better suited for detecting the static human target in larger distances.

articleTitle: Research on a kind of anti-podal Vivaldi antenna
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper researched a kind of antipodal Vivaldi antenna for passive guidance radar application on the missile. In order to achieve better characteristics of end-fire, a rectangular slot was used to change the antenna surface current distribution on the basis of the original antenna. To solve the problem of low gain for the conventional antipodal Vivaldi antenna, an ellipse parasitic patch was introduced at the end of radiation zone of the antipodal Vivaldi antenna. Simulation results showed that the average gain of the antenna is increased by 2.5dBi. Finally, this paper discussed the performance changes of the antipodal Vivaldi antenna unit when it is conformal with the surface of a cylinder. The analysis and simulation result were provided and can be as a technical reference for the practical engineering application.

articleTitle: Two-side data deduplication mechanism for non-center cloud storage systems
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: Unnecessarily redundant data wastes lots of storage resource of cloud storage system. In this paper, we focus on the data deduplication for the non-center cloud storage system and propose a novel two-side data deduplication mechanism. First, duplicated data is detected in client side and prevented to be uploaded to cloud data center, and then new-generated duplicated data is detected and deleted in cloud server side. The Chord algorithm is optimized through the compressed finger table and the search optimization of finger table and used to construct the logical network, which makes searching the fingerprint much faster in storage nodes. The experimental results show that the improved Chord algorithm has the better performance than the original one in the number of fingerprint values and the cost of searching time, and the proposed two-side data deduplication mechanism has the higher rate of deduplication than the traditional data deduplication mechanism.

articleTitle: The research on the design of the KU-band ultra-wideband RF receiver
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper provide the detailed design of a RF frontend receiver system in 14GHz with intermediate frequency 1.6GHz, 1GHz radio frequency bandwidth. The receiver uses the traditional superheterodyne structure, able to obtain high receiver sensitivity and channel selectivity and small size. The tests' results show that the overall receiver performance is generally satisfactory. In the receiver, the gain flatness is less than 3.8dB, the overall gain is about 71dB. For the 800MHz QPSK modulated signals within the passband, signal EVM value is 24.6, SNR is 12.2.

articleTitle: Accurate modeling of three-port center-tapped octagonal inductors for SPDT switch design in 0.13-μm BiCMOS
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: An accurate modeling of three-port center-tapped inductors is proposed in this paper, which is specially designed to achieve high performance with the symmetrically octagonal twin shape for a 60-GHz single-pole double-throw (SPDT) switch application in a 0.13-μm SiGe BiCMOS technology. The developed modeling of on-chip inductors includes the 3-D physical model for actual chip fabrication and the double-π equivalent-circuit model for precise parameter extraction, respectively. The simulation results of the physical and equivalent-circuit models agree well with the total inductance of 146 pH and high Q of 22.57 at the desired operating frequency of 60 GHz. Finally, a 60-GHz SPDT switch has been implemented to verify the accuracy of the inductor modeling using only CMOS devices of 0.13-μm SiGe BiCMOS technology.

articleTitle: Design of planar ultra-wideband antenna with polarization diversity and high isolation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper has presented a compact planar antenna for ultra-wideband (UWB) multiple-input-multiple-output (MIMO) applications. The polarization diversity is obtained by employing dual planar UWB antenna elements and rotating one 90 degrees with respect to the other one. The microstrip-fed element consists of a rectangular ground plane and a rectangular radiating patch. In addition, an inverted-L shaped strip is connected to the ground plane for reducing the whole size and improving the impedance matching. The results have confirmed that the proposed element occupies a size of 24×16×0.8 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and achieves a wideband bandwidth from 3 to over 10 GHz. Moreover, the operating frequency band of the UWB MIMO antenna with a size of 24×44×0.8 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> can cover 3-10 GHz and the port-to-port isolation is around 20 dB.

articleTitle: Design and realization of a 13-bit serial to parallel GaAs digital circuit for 6–18 GHz T/R module
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: In this paper, a 13-bit serial to parallel GaAs digital circuit based on GaAs 0.15um Enhancement-Depletion(ED) PHEMT has been realized and measured. This serial to parallel circuit is designed for the 6-18 GHz T/R module, it controls 1-bit switch, 6-bit shifter and 6-bit attenuator. This GaAs logic circuit could reduce the size of T/R module chip and improve the integration degree of the system. The simulated and measured data on some basic logic cells (NOR logic gate, levelshifter) is shown in the paper. We also tested a 6-bit serial to parallel logic testcell. The 13-bit serial to parallel logic circuit work successfully in the whole T/R module.

articleTitle: A hybrid explicit-implicit discontinuous Galerkin spectral-element time-domain algorithm for multi-scale computation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a hybrid explicit-implicit discontinuous Galerkin spectral-element time-domain (DG-SETD) algorithm for the analysis of multi-scale electromagnetic problems. Usually very small cells and extremely small time step size is needed in multi-scale simulation. However, when using this method, the time step size is no longer constrained by the Courant-Friedrichs-Levy (CFL) condition and the number of unknowns will also be greatly reduced by nonconformal mesh, which can greatly shorten the computation time. The Crank-Nicholson (CN) difference scheme is employed for the small cells with UMFPACK solver and leapfrog difference is for the large cells with direct solution procedure. Consequently, a relatively large time step size can be adopted. Finally, numerical results demonstrate the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Design of the wide band transmitter for the Ku band RF frontend
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: Implementation of a wideband RF transmitter is reported in this paper. In order to achieve the best performance, a super heterodyne architecture with RF of 14GHz and IF of 1.6GHz is employed, and the signal bandwidth is 1000MHz. Finally, measurement results of the transmitter are provided and the overall system performance indicated by EVM (Error Vector Magnitude) with 100MHz signal bandwidth (maximum digital modulation bandwidth available from Agilent with up to date measurement method) is reported.

articleTitle: Application of overlapped domain decomposition method to combined current and charge integral equation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: The overlapped domain decomposition method is applied to the combined current and charge integral equation formulation for efficiently analyzing electromagnetic scattering in low frequency. The hybrid method is fast convergent when one of charge unknowns is removed for eliminating linear dependence in charges. In the method, only part of impedance matrix needs to be stored into memory, which reduces the memory requirement, significantly. Numerical examples validate its efficiency.

articleTitle: Marching-on-in-degree time-domain integral equation solver with high-level basis functions for transient electromagnetic scattering
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: In this paper, the transient electromagnetic scattering of the benchmark target, i.e. the NASA almond, is calculated utilizing the marching-on-in-degree time-domain integral equation method with high-level spatial and temporal basis functions. Much memory requirement reduction and unconditionally stable solution in late time can be ensured. The time-domain solution is then Fourier transformed, and wide frequency band information is obtained. As a further discussion of the previous work of the authors, numerical results of the NASA almond are provided and discussed.

articleTitle: Robust fairness-ensuring beamforming with imperfect CSI in cloud radio access networks
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: The cloud radio access network (C-RAN) is sensitive to the constrained fronthaul links and imperfect channel state information (CSI). In this paper, a robust fairness-ensuring beamforming is designed for the fronthaul-constrained C-RAN with imperfect CSI. In particular, an enhanced imperfect CSI model is formulated, in which four kinds of error sources are considered. Based on the proposed model, the mean square error (MSE) of the received message is derived. To guarantee the fairness amongst user equipments, a max-MSE minimization optimization problem is formulated, which is non-convex. To address the non-convexity, a robust algorithm is proposed by introducing auxiliary variables and ℓ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>-ℓ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> norm conversion. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness and fairness of the proposed robust max-MSE minimization algorithm under different error conditions.

articleTitle: Miniaturized dual-band circularly polarized antenna design and realization based on cavity resonator structure
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: A dual-band circularly polarized microstrip antenna of airborne is designed in this paper. The antenna has a miniaturized structure, which use two patches and cavity to coupling two resonant frequencies. The corner of lower patch is fed with SMD directional coupler, gap between the upper patch and the cavity resonance high frequency. Designed antenna size is 300mm * 300mm * 87mm (equivalent to 0.348λ0 of the center of low-frequency). Antenna measurement shows that VSWR is less than 1.7 in 348 MHz frequency band (341 MHz-354 MHz) and 388 MHz frequency band (381 MHz-396 MHz). Circular polarization axial ratio of normal direction is less than 2.4dB in each frequency band. It achieves LHCP in two frequency bands. The antenna gains achieved of two frequency bands are both more than 6.7dBi. Testing results and simulation results are consistent.

articleTitle: Design of low side-lobe level conformai antenna array by PSO-GA
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: In this paper, the particle swarm optimization (PSO) method and genetic algorithm (GA) are combined and applied to optimize the antenna radiation pattern of conformal array. We improve the traditional PSO method by using inertia weight factor and prevent PSO method from getting stuck at a local optimum. And circular and cylindrical conformal antenna arrays are investigated, respectively. Compared with the traditional PSO algorithm, the novel GA-PSO method can speed up the convergence.

articleTitle: The application of spatial filtered FDTD method in fine structures
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: The Courant-Friedrichs-Lewy (CFL) condition has been considered to be a benchmark that ensures stable electromagnetic modeling while using explicit finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method. It has been recently shown that the stability limit of FDTD can be surpassed by filtering unstable high frequency components for computational domain within uniform grids. As many models only have fine structure in one direction. According to this, in this paper, a novel spatially filtered FDTD (SF-FDTD) method is developed to get a new normalized cut-off radius of the spatially filtering. The results from the novel SF-FDTD agree well with the results from standard FDTD, and the required CPU time for this method is much shorter than that of the FDTD method.

articleTitle: Improved 3-D MIMO-RMA based on modified sampling scheme
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper introduces a 3-D near-field range migration (RM) imaging algorithm oriented for MIMO array configuration. The image reconstruction process is performed in the range-cross range domain and requires a modified sampling scheme. The proposed algorithm is able to provide high quality images for short range targets with high computational efficiency. The proposed algorithm is tested by numerical simulation. The result demonstrates its high accuracy and computational efficiency for near-field MIMO array imaging.

articleTitle: A design and implementation of logistics management system of RFID based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: Nowadays, people pay more and more attention to logistics management. However, due to the global e-commerce supply chain information transfer is not timely; information distortion and system error, hundreds of billions of dollars every year have lost. In order to improve the efficiency of logistics management system and reduce the error rate, people put forward RFID logistics management system. At the same time, because the embedded technology has the advantages of flexibility, high integration and low price, the use of embedded technology to realize RFID becomes the mainstream. This paper, combining the two, designs a RFID logistics management system based on Nios II. The system consists of a Nios II embedded soft core, a FPGA, a LCD screen, a matrix keyboard etc. After test, it can read the information of goods in a certain range and show them on a LCD screen and users can use a keyboard to manage the warehouse. It also helps to improve the efficiency of logistics management and reduce the error rate.

articleTitle: Parallel hierarchical-matrix-based algorithm for solving electromagnetic scattering problems
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: In this paper, a parallel Hierarchical-Matrix-Based Algorithm is developed to deal with the fast electromagnetic scattering computation, In order to get a good load balancing a partition scheme for the matrix is used, each process owns the resource needed to execute the program. Finally, Compared with Hierarchical-Matrix-Based method, the results show that parallel H-matrix-based method has a high parallel efficiency for solving electromagnetic scattering from conducting bodies.

articleTitle: Efficient analysis of mircrostrip antenna arrays through using characteristic modes
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: An efficient method is proposed for the radiation solution of microstrip antenna arrays made of identical elements. This method is based on the formula of volume surface integral equation (VSIE) solved by the method of moments (MoM). The characteristic modes (CM) of the single element are applied as entire-domain basis functions to reduce the impedance matrix of the whole array. It allows the analysis of large arrays with direct inversion methods. A source mode (SM) obtained by subtracting several dominant CMs from the exact current of a single element is added to expand the current due to the slow convergence when using CMs to approximate the current excited by a delta gap source. Numerical results have shown a good agreement between the solution of MoM and the present method. Meanwhile, the memory requirements and computational time of the proposed method reduce obviously.

articleTitle: Posterior Cramér-Rao lower bound for mobile emitter tracking based on a TDOA-FDOA multi-measurement model
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: Tracking a mobile radio emitter in a high clutter environment with low signal to noise ratio is a challenging task due to high miss detection and false alarm rates in the joint time difference of arrival (TDOA) and frequency difference of arrival (FDOA) estimation procedure. To increase the probability of detection, multiple TDOA-FDOA measurements from a number of peaks in the cross ambiguity function (CAF) are collected. In this paper, the posterior Cramér-Rao lower bound (PCRLB) based on such a multi-measurement model is derived. Different hypotheses are assigned to the measurement set and the prior probability of each hypothesis is defined. The Fisher information matrix (FIM) is computed based on the likelihood of a combination of all these hypotheses. As such, the proposed PCRLB is able to take the information from miss detection and false alarm as well as the target into account. It is therefore more accurate and more attainable than the bound derived from the single measurement extracted from the largest peak of the CAF. Tracking performance via particle filtering is employed to validate the derived performance bound.

articleTitle: Novel high gain and compact UWB antenna using multiple radiation arms loaded with rectangular patches
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: A novel high gain ultra-wideband (UWB) antenna is proposed. In its planar configuration, multiple radiation elements are employed in order to achieve both miniaturization and high gain. Meanwhile, a symmetric polygon is etched on the metal ground for improving the impedance matching in such a wide frequency band. The optimized geometric dimensions are obtained via full-wave simulation. A prototype of the proposed antenna is fabricated and measured results are compared with simulated results. The results show that the proposed antenna design achieves good performance as predicted.

articleTitle: Rapid prototyping and validation on an SDR platform of a low-cost hybrid ML SNR estimator over time-varying SIMO channels
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: An application of a rapid prototyping method on an SDR platform is presented. A novel low-cost hybrid maximum likelihood (ML)signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) estimator over single-input multiple-output (SIMO) time-varying fading channels, is implemented, tested, and validated. The approach adopted to achieve this work is modelbased. It requires no coding since it is relies on MAT-LAB/Simulink and Xilinx Sytsem Generator (XSG) tools that offer a graphical user interface (GUI) and a drag- and-drop method. These software tools allow the creation of a design architecture for the estimator which is then translated into hardware description language (HDL) and implemented on the targeted SDR. Nutaq's PicoSDR2X2 platform and Anite's EB Propsim channel emulator define our experimental environment. The experimental results obtained in real-time and over-the-air corroborate those previously generated off-line by MATLAB.

articleTitle: A fully-integrated Ka-band CMOS power amplifier with Psat of 20 dBm and PAE of 19%
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper presents a 27.5-28.5 GHz Ka-band power amplifier fabricated with 0.13 pm CMOS process. A small inter-stage inductor between the cascode common-source and common-gate is designed to improve PA's output power and PAE. A vertical coupling input and output balun with low insertion loss are designed to simultaneously perform impedance transformation and differential to single-ended conversion. The power amplifier achieves a saturated output power (Psat) of 20 dBm and a maximum power gain (G) of 22.6 dB, the peak value of the power added efficiency (PAE) is 19 %.

articleTitle: A data cache optimization approach for coarse grain reconfigurable architecture for multimedia applications
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper proposes a data Cache optimization method for coarse grain reconfigurable architecture for multimedia applications to improve the data flow of the reconfigurable system with low on-chip memory cost, including the novel data Cache structure and the related Cache management strategy, especially the updating method for the data Cache. The proposed data cache structure has been adopted in a reconfigurable system called REMUS-HPP. The experimental results show that the approach is efficient for various multimedia applications, and the memory access performance of the reconfigurable system can be improved by 47.02%-53.20% with a very low memory cost of 4Kbytes.

articleTitle: A resource allocation algorithm for multi-lined phased arrays
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: A fixed strategy is proposed to establish a resource allocation algorithm for tracking multiple targets distributed in hemispherical space with a multi-lined phased array, with the consideration of the beam priorities and the power limitation. Some test examples are given for verification.

articleTitle: Serially concatenated multiple parity-check codes for secure communication
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: In this paper, two secure codes are studied for a Gaussian wiretap channel. These two secure codes are derived from Multiple Parity-Check (MPC) codes, therefore, have low encoding complexities. These two codes are called M-SC-MPC codes and M-QC-MPC codes, respectively, in this paper. Theoretical security analysis show that these codes guarantees perfect secrecy against an eavesdropper. Simulation results show that the bit error rate of the proposed codes is close to 0.5 at low SNR region and very low at high SNR region over the AWGN channel with iterative decoding.

articleTitle: Power-aware optimization for CS-based IR-UWB system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: Compressed sensing (CS) is an emerging technology that can be applied to impulse radio ultra-wideband (IR-UWB) receivers. CS represents an attractive solution for its capability of recovering a signal from a small number of measurements using sub-Nyquist sampling rate analog to digital converters (ADC). In this paper we investigate practical design parameters for low power CS based UWB system, including pulse bandwidth, number of measurements and frame length. Considering the FCC mask, three different pulses are compared in noisy environment in order to provide an optimal solution for high bit rate and low bit rate applications. Performance impact on number of measurements and frame length are also evaluated so that minimum numbers and length can be used for power saving.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of broadband coaxial cable network for WIFI signal
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: In order to effectively solve the instable problem of wireless signal transmission in modern architecture, the scheme of using coaxial cable to transmit 2.4GHz wireless signal is proposed. Firstly, the feasibility of wireless signal which transmit in coaxial cable is analyzed and measured. Next, the former result is compared with the typical values of propagation attenuation of wireless signal spreading in free space. Finally, the better transmission performance of WIFI signal is verified, which spreading in coaxial cable compared to free space in modern architecture.

articleTitle: Estimation of source association based on a novel TDOA algorithm of multi-cycle frequencies
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: In this paper, we develop a new method to solve the issue of which path belonging to which emission source under multipath propagation, i.e., estimation of source association. To improve the performance of source association estimation, we propose a new TDOA estimation algorithm with a weighted linear combination of cyclic correlation functions based on multi-cycle frequencies. Several simulations have been performed to analyze the performance of this algorithm, and the results verify the effectiveness of the new method.

articleTitle: Equivalence between stepped-impedance ring and T-shaped cascaded transmission line network
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: Two new equivalences in transmission line (TL) networks are proposed. The first one is found between a shunt fed stepped-impedance ring and a T-shaped TL network with a short-circuited series stub. Both the networks are composed of TL segments with the same electrical length. By using the Y and the ABCD matrices, an equivalent condition can be obtained, which is independent in frequency. Meeting the condition, the two networks with different topologies could generate exactly the same response. As the counterpart of the first one, the second equivalence is found between a series fed ring and a T-shaped network with an open-circuited shunt stub. The two equivalences are useful in circuit modelling and analysis; and provide extra design flexibility in circuit implementations.

articleTitle: A compact UWB band-pass filter using embedded circular slot structures for improved upper stop-band performance
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper presents an ultra-wideband band-pass filter designed using a slot-line ring resonator and two pairs of embedded circular slot structures. The slot-line ring resonator is used to form the desired UWB passband, and the upper stop-band response is suppressed by embedding the circular slot structures into the ring resonator. This is different from conventional designs using cascaded bandstop/low-pass filters for stop-band response suppression, which usually leads to big circuit sizes. And hence the proposed approach can reduce the circuit size significantly. A prototype filter with a compact size (13.6 mm×6.75 mm) has been implemented for experimental validation. The measured results show a -3 dB frequency band from 3.4 GHz to 11.7 GHz and > 20 dB upper stop-band suppression from 12.5 GHz to 20GHz.

articleTitle: A radar simulation system based on the path files
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper presents a radar simulation system based on the path files. The geocentric coordinate system was converted to the earth-rectangular coordinate system. We can obtain the information of the target's position and velocity by complex radar signal processing. The simulation results are consistent with the actual value.

articleTitle: Characterization of 2.6GHz wireless channel in meeting room scenario using reverberation theory
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: A novel model of the path loss and power delay profile in a meeting room scenario is proposed. The parameters of the model are estimated from extensive measurements of a wireless channel under Line-Of-Sight conditions at 2.6 GHz. The model is improved by using reverberation theory to characterize relevant properties of primary and reverberant components varying with distance. Furthermore, the model is extended to a joint distance-obstruction-dependent model by including the number of obstacles as a parameter. The results indicate that the proposed model based on reverberation time is more accurate than the power law model. The proposed reverberation model can be used in physical layer algorithm development of future wireless communication system.

articleTitle: Electrical properties analysis of conical radome
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: For anti-radiation missile radome, to ensure the electrical properties of a passive antenna, it needs higher microwave transmittance in lager frequency range; for active antenna, on the basis of ensuring microwave transmittance, it also needs to restrict more indicators such as 3dB beam width variations and sighting errors in operating frequency of active antenna. Moreover, in order to facilitate design and simulation, the shape of aircraft radome usually use regular geometric structure such as conic, hemispherical and tangent ogive structure to approximately substitute in engineering. In this paper, for the needs of actual project, we simulate and analyze the conical radome with A-sandwich structure by four-port equivalent transmission line theories and PO physical optics. Then we can achieve electrical properties indicators of radome which include that microwave transmittance is larger than 80% in 2~ 16GHz band and the variation of the half power beam width is smaller than 10% when the frequency is 13GHz and the sighting error is smaller than 0.2°.

articleTitle: A miniaturized wideband power divider
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: A new miniaturized microstrip wideband power divider is proposed. The divider consists of two-section impedance transformers and two extra transmission lines connected to the output ports. Lumped components are applied to realize the isolation between output ports. The overall circuit size is reduced compared with other previously published work. For verifying the proposed structure, one prototype with the center frequency of 2 GHz was fabricated and measured. The measured relative bandwidth is about 100% from 1GHz to 3 GHz with return loss and isolation better than 20dB.

articleTitle: The intra-cluster blind detection algorithm of simple ant swarm optimization for wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: Combining the theory of correlation and simple ant colony optimization blind algorithms, basing on the transmission cluster partition model of wireless sensor networks, we propose a new blind detection scheme. The scheme first uses blind detection algorithm based on simple ant colony optimization algorithms to derive the reference node information and in turn, to estimate the transmission channel. It then combines the anti-estimated transmission channel of reference sensor nodes to recover other non-reference nodes information in the clusters according to the correlation among the transmission signal of each sensor in the model. Simulation results show the feasibility of the scheme.

articleTitle: Unified access control for 5G convergence network with DHCP
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: Traditionally wireline network and wireless network have been operated and managed separately. Future network will provide converged network service on wireline and wireless networks together. Service requirement for unified access to both wireline and wireless networks emerged as we experience more sophisticated network services. This paper discusses a unified access control for 5G convergence network with multiplicity of different access networks. With minor change onto Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP) we can reuse authentication information among various access technologies on 5G convergence network. The proposed method enables us to reuse authentication information from one access network onto another access network. Authentication reuse and unified access control will reduce complexity of 5G convergence network access procedure with multiple access networks and provide consistent access procedure regardless what access technology a user chooses to use.

articleTitle: China different heights annually THz wave atmospheric absorption calculation
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: The quantitative calculation of THz wave atmospheric absorption attenuation, especially at actually region's different heights, are always been fundamental and key technology application for variety terahertz communication modes, such as wideband & high-speed network, astro-satellite communication, altitude aero-craft communication, long distance vast data transfer, short range wireless security communication etc. In this paper, the 2012 annually reanalysis data selected from National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) is employing to calculate the China region THz wave statistical monthly atmospheric absorption attenuation at different heights. Optimal Spline-3 function fitting method is using to fit NCEP discrete meteorological data into continuous curves. Based on Millimeter Propagation Model (MPM) as well as ITU Recommendation, the paper made China 2012 monthly barometric pressure, temperature, relative humidity curves, and different heights THz wave Oxygen and water vapor absorption comparison to get China region's statistical THz wave atmospheric absorption universal principles.

articleTitle: Miniaturized lumped-element LTCC quadrature hybrid with harmonics suppression
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: A compact lumped-element low temperature co-fired ceramic (LTCC) quadrature hybrid with harmonics suppression is proposed. The proposed topology enables significant circuit size reduction using spiral inductors with orthogonal input/output ports and vertical interdigital capacitors (VICs) placed in center of the hybrid. The overall size of the LTCC hybrid is only 11 × 11 × 1 mm. Electromagnetic (EM) — simulated S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>, S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf>, S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">31</inf> and S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">41</inf> are better than −25, −2.8, −3.9 and −25 dB at 130 MHz, respectively. And the phase balance between the coupled and direct ports is 89.9° at 130 MHz. Moreover, 24 dB suppression for the second harmonic and 36 dB suppression for the third harmonic are obtained.

articleTitle: Route optimization algorithm based on multi-lanes in VANET
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: As a kind of special form of mobile ad hoc networks, VANET receives more and more attention for providing safety and entertainment news. The frequent changes of topology caused by high-speed mobile vehicles will cause routing unreachable, leading to loss of data packets eventually. So, routing protocols used in the VANET need to be improved to enhance the reliability and effectiveness. An improved routing protocol called IGRP is proposed in this article which has the following features compared with the GRP. The connectivity probability is considered when choosing the most suitable path based on a three-lanes path model which is proposed in the article. Forwarding mechanism is also improved which will choose the neighbor node with the highest priority to forward. Different allocation algorithm of priority are proposed for straight roads and intersections. Simulation shows that the proposed protocol outperforms exiting routing protocols in terms of data delivery rate, average transmission delay with a little cost of routing overhead.

articleTitle: Average received interference power analysis of D2D communication in the cellular network
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This study investigates the average received interference power of Device-to-Device (D2D) communication in the cellular network, where multiple cellular users are uniformly distributed inside this cell, and the allocated uplink resources are reused by D2D. First, based on the parameter estimation of two-dimensional uniform distribution in a circle, and the general approach to generating a random variable from a distribution, we derive the exact expression for the average interference power of the D2D receiver. Then, with the upper bound of the derived expression, we analyze the variation tendency of the interference power. This is achieved by taking derivatives and using the property of the Lambert W function. Analytical results demonstrate that the interference power firstly increase and then decrease with the increasing radial coordinate of the D2D receiver. Finally, we present simulations and numerical results to validate the derivation and analysis.

articleTitle: Compressive massive MIMO calibration
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: Massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) offers ample spectral efficiency gains by installing hundreds of antenna elements at one single base station (BS). To learn the downlink (DL) channel state information (CSI) from the uplink (UL) channel measurements at the BS, it is critical to be able to take full advantage of time-division duplexing (TDD) channel reciprocity. However, due to different radio frequency branches for transmitting and receiving, antenna calibration at the BS is necessary to effect this reciprocity between the end-to-end DL and UL channels. In massive MIMO, this task becomes extremely challenging since all the existing antenna calibration approaches do not scale well with the size of the antenna array. In this paper, we rely on compressive sensing (CS) theory to develop an efficient way to calibrate the massive antenna array at the BS, which only requires CSI feedback in the order of O(log N) instead of O(N) as in those conventional calibration schemes. Simulations demonstrate our approach can maintain the whole large scale antenna system in a “calibrated” state with only a small amount of feedback overhead.

articleTitle: Equalization techniques to ensure signal integrity in high speed serial and optical design
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: With the rapid progression of communication industry towards Multi-gigabit era, the existence of Inter symbol Interference (ISI) has been creating issues that require serious consideration. The advancement of world communication research towards 5G and upwards as well as further introduction of electronic devices designed for Multi-Gigabit data transfer have created an affinity for greater exploration on Equalization Techniques, Compared to the past with low data rates. Equalization techniques are used for ensuring that the receiver (Rx) measures the same pattern as the transmitter (Tx). Hence correcting the errors caused by transmission path is the said intention for utilizing Equalization techniques. In this paper, comparative analysis between different equalization techniques has been highlighted via Matlab simulation. Additionally, for high speed serial link design and Optical link, Advance Design System (ADS) and OpticWave simulations were performed and compared receiver output via Q-factor and Eye pattern, both with and without implementing Equalization.

articleTitle: Angle estimation for bistatic MIMO radar based on core tensor PARAFAC decomposition
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper discusses the problem of joint direction-of-departure (DOD) and direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation for bistatic multiple-input multiple-output radar. A three-order tensor model is formulated to exploit the multidimensional structure inherent the received data. To obtain an accurate angle estimation in low signal-to-noise ratio scene, the high-dimensional tensor data is then compressed to core tensor. Joint DOD and DOA estimation is linked to PARAFAC decomposition of the core tensor data. The proposed algorithm can achieve automatic pairing of the estimated angles and outperform the existing methods. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Fast solving EM scattering from penetrable objects with non-conformal multiple-traces PMCHWT equations
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: In this paper, a non-conformal multiple-traces Poggio-Miller-Chang-Harrington-Wu-Tsai (PMCHWT) method is developed for solving electromagnetic (EM) scattering from dielectric objects. Different from traditional single trace PMCHWT (ST-PMCHWT) method, the non-conformal multiple-trace PMCHWT (MT-PMCHWT) method discrete the surface unknowns with two pair of non-conformal meshes (exterior, interior). Also, The transmission conditions (TCs) is enforced to ensure the continuity of currents, on the interface of the exterior free space domain and interior dielectric space domain.

articleTitle: Delay-aware resource allocation for device-to-device communication underlaying cloud radio access networks
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: A dynamic optimization problem for resource allocation in device-to-device communication underlaying cloud radio access networks (C-RANs) is researched in this paper. To optimize network throughput as well as maintain delay-aware network, a resource allocation problem with power consumption, fronthaul capacity, and network stability constraints is formulated for the downlink of C-RAN, where the delay-aware network is confirmed by the stability. Then Lyapunov optimization approach is used to transform the problem to an equivalent optimal beamformer design problem, which can be addressed by a weighted minimum mean square error approach based algorithm. Simulation results show that the proposed algorithm achieves a tradeoff between throughput and stability.

articleTitle: A small size antenna for UHF RFID tag mountable on metallic objects
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This letter presents the design of a small and low-profile RFID tag antenna in the UHF band that can be mounted on metallic objects. The size of the proposed tag is 40mm × 24mm × 3mm. The sloted patch inductively fed by a couple loop with a shorting vole, further more by adding parasitic patches which are coupled the driven patch to enhance the bandwidth of the tag. The designed tag antenna can work at the 920 MHz frequency band and is able to maintain a good performance on the metal surface with 3dB return loss bandwidth of the proposed antenna is 45MHz, and the gain of the antenna is 2.1dB, which satisfactorily operates on metal plates, so it is applicable in many applications.

articleTitle: Internet-of-vehicle-oriented fatigue driving state detection mechanism
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: Fatigue driving is one of the most common dangerous driving state. When a driver is fatigue, his or her reaction speed will be reduced, which will easily lead to traffic accidents if not manipulated in time. It is an effective way to realize the detection and adjustment of the driver's fatigue state based on the Internet of vehicle. Current fatigue driving state detection mechanisms usually have some obvious defects, including low detection accuracy rate, high hardware cost, uncomfortable wearing experience, high environmental requirement, etc. We propose a novel Internet-of-vehicle-oriented fatigue driving state detecting mechanism based on data fusion with the Dempster-Shafer (D-S) evidence theory. We apply the D-S evidence theory to combine the above two initial detection results to realize the decision level fusion, in order to get a better result. We design and construct the prototype system of the Internet-of-vehicles-oriented fatigue driving state detection. The experimental results show that, compared with the existing methods, the proposed mechanism has the certain advantage in the detection accuracy rate. We also implement a series of experiments to compare three fatigue driving state detecting mechanisms from the response time, time complexity and memory consumption.

articleTitle: A data routing algorithm based on Markov model in underwater wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: The underwater wireless sensor networks (UWSNs) composed of sensor nodes is deployed underwater for submarine data collection, underwater monitoring, disaster warning, navigation assistance and so on. Since the underwater environment is usually unpredictable, and the nodes move or be damaged easily, so there are several vital objectives in UWSN routing such as the delivery success rate, the error rate and the energy consumption. To this end, we propose a data routing algorithm based on Markov model, which logically transforms the underwater three-dimensional (3D) deployment model into a two-dimensional (2D) model, and thus the nodes are considered to be hierarchically deployed. The data routing is achieved through bottom-top forwarding. In this forwarding mode, the delivery success rate can be improved and the energy consumption can be reduced due to the more stable routing, less forwarding counts and better adaptability to the dynamic load.

articleTitle: Blind-spot analysis of localization networks using second-order blocking statistics
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: The blocking of line-of-sight between anchors and targets by distributed (i.e., non-point) obstacles in an environment can create blind-spots in a localization network if there are an insufficient number of unblocked anchors. The spatial randomness of the obstacle and anchor locations makes it difficult to characterize the blind-spot probability of a network. In this paper, we use tools from stochastic geometry to characterize this randomness. In particular, a homogeneous Poisson point process is used to model the anchor locations and a germ-grain model is employed to represent obstacle locations and shapes. Unlike previous works, which usually assume independent blocking of anchors, we develop tools to handle correlated blocking. Specifically, we use a mixture distribution to approximate the variance of the unshadowed area, which in turn, is used to approximate the blind-spot probability.

articleTitle: A 36–41GHz power amplifier with distributed active transformer in 0.13 μm CMOS process
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: A 36-41GHz fully integrated power amplifier with distributed active transformer (DAT) in 0.13 pm CMOS technology is presented in this paper. In order to improve the output power of the PA, a four-way distributed active transformer was used for power combining. The DAT combiner not only can realize efficient performance of power combination, but also directly match the PA unit. Moreover, the patterned floating shield (PFS) and patterned ground shield (PGS) are utilized to reduce the insertion loss of the DAT, on-chip balun and power splitter. PA units employ cascode stage and cascade of common source stage to improve the gain and output power. This DAT PA achieves a peak power gain of 12.5 dB with 20dBm saturated output power and a peak power added efficiency (PAE) of 10% under the supply voltage of 1.6V and current consumption of 152 mA. The entire PA core occupies 0.78 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> die area.

articleTitle: Design of a nano-power fully autonomous multi-source energy harvesting circuit
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper presents a nano-power fully autonomous multi-source energy harvesting circuit for solar, thermal, and vibration energy. A low-power active rectifier is employed to improve vibration energy extraction efficiency. A maximum power point tracking circuit based on a fractional open-circuit voltage technique is applied to solar and thermal channels. A passive self-starting technique makes the harvester autonomous and performs a battery-less start-up from a fully discharged state. An asynchronous logic is adopted for the control unit to reduce intrinsic power consumption. Simulation results show that, as low as 100nA quiescent current in all is drawn by the converter and a peak conversion efficiency of 83.6% is achieved. There are only four external components: two capacitors for DC sources, a single inductor and an external capacitor for energy storage.

articleTitle: Secrecy rate region maximization for multi-user MIMO systems with artificial noise and service integration
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper considers an artificial noise (AN)-aided transmit design for multi-user MIMO systems with integrated services. Specifically, two sorts of service messages are combined and serve simultaneously: one multicast message intended for all receivers and one confidential message intended for only one receiver. The confidential message is kept perfectly secure from all the unauthorized receivers. Our goal is to jointly design the input covariances for the multicast message, confidential message and AN, such that the achievable secrecy rate region is maximized subject to the sum power constraint. This problem is a vector optimization problem and inherently complex to solve. To find its Pareto boundary, the method of scalarization is used to transform it into an equivalent scalar optimization problem. Nonetheless, this scalar optimization problem is nonconvex and appears to be difficult especially in our considered scenario. Then we show that this problem can be handled by resorting to an alternating optimization (AO) algorithm. The merit of this AO algorithm lies in its provable convergence to one stationary point. Numerical results are finally presented to show the efficacy of our proposed method.

articleTitle: Wideband filtering power divider based on coupled-lines and short-circuited stubs
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: A novel wideband filtering power divider based on coupled-lines and short-circuited stubs is proposed in this paper. By using multisection λ/4 coupled-lines with two short-circuited stubs placed in shunt with the input port of the power divider, the presented circuit can successfully realize wideband property and high frequency selectivity. In addition, two resistors are properly selected according to the even-/odd-mode analysis for improving the isolation performance. For demonstration, two typical ideal simulations with 15-dB bandwidth of 80% and 20-dB bandwidth of 56% operating at 2 GHz are implemented, respectively. The simulated results show excellent agreement with theoretically predicated results.

articleTitle: Research on multiple uncorrelated Rayleigh channels model and performance analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper deals with the design of an improvement multiple uncorrelated Rayleigh fading waveforms. Based on the uncorrelated requirement of optimal signal Angle of Arrival (AOA) for Sum-of-Sinusoids (SOS) model, a new AOA form is given. The new form guarantees the uncorrelated statistical performance and has good agreements with Clarke reference model. Both results of theoretical analysis and numerical simulation show that the single channel statistics of the new model is better than other models. The proposed method is useful for the design of simulation models for diversity-combined Rayleigh fading channels, relay fading channels, and frequency-selective channels.

articleTitle: Fast compressed spectrum sensing on positioning technology
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: A non-reconstruction compressed sensing(CS) is applied in spectrum detection by sacrificing some accuracy rate. Collaborative spectrum sensing can improve the probability of detection(Pd). Meanwhile, second user(SU) far from primary user(PU) will reduce the total performance for distance reason. We proposed an algorithm by using non-reconstruction compressed sensing with considering distance of SU to PU by positioning technology. The numerical simulations results proved the effectiveness of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Stability of the extended six-stage split-step FDTD method including lumped inductors
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: The stability of the six-stage split-step finite-difference time-domain (SS-FDTD) method including lumped inductors is studied. In particular, three different formulations for the lumped inductors are analyzed: the explicit, semi-implicit, and implicit schemes. Then, its numerical stability is analytically proven by the von Neumann method, and the results show that the proposed method is unconditionally stable in the semi-implicit and implicit schemes, whereas it is conditionally stable in the explicit scheme, which its stability is related to both the mesh size and values of the element. Finally, a simple microstrip circuit including a lumped inductor is simulated to demonstrate the validity of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Design of the high-performance radio frequency receiver for IEEE 802.11ac system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper presents the design of RF receiver operating in 5.0GHz to 6.0GHz band for high throughput IEEE 802.11ac system. A double-conversion super-heterodyne architecture with IF of 1.05GHz is employed and the maximum bandwidth is 80MHz. Measurement results show that the receiver has excellent performance. The noise figure is about 4.6dB and the gain flatness over any 80MHz bandwidth is less than 1.8dB. In addition, it achieves a wide dynamic range from -80dBm to 5dBm. For 80MHz 256-QAM 802.11ac signal, the EVMs at 5.15GHz, 5.45GHz and 5.85GHz are 1.02%, 0.86% and 0.86% respectively.

articleTitle: Blind detection algorithm based on WSN air quality monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: Aiming at the blind detection of the air quality monitoring system, based on cluster processing of Wireless Sensor Network, combined with WSN blind detection internal model in literature, this paper proposes self-regulating mutation differential evolution to restore signals of reference sensor, then uses newly-constructed model to experiment on the system. Simulation demonstrates that compared with traditional difference blind equalization algorithm, BER of improved algorithm is obviously reduced while all internal sensor data can be restored under acceptable condition.

articleTitle: Research on 89GHz dual-polarization direct detection radiometer
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: The passive radiometer is a health-safe alternative to other imaging techniques conceived to be used on human beings for security or medical purposes. An 89GHz dual-polarization radiometer based on direct detection is developed and experimented in this paper. The radiometer system consists of an Orthomode Transducer(OMT) with 18dB return loss and 0.25dB insertion loss, filter and amplify circuits and square-law detectors. The final measurement shows that in the band 88-90GHz, the noise figure(NF) is less than 3.6dB, the sensitivity of the radiometer is less than 2.3K(@Integral time 50us), and the linearity is better than 0.9999 for both the horizontal polarization and the vertical polarization.

articleTitle: High selectivity balanced filter with multiple transmission zeros using ring resonators
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: A high selectivity balanced filter with multiple transmission zeros using ring resonators is proposed in this paper. Six transmission zeros are easily realized to improve the differential mode passband selectivity and common mode suppression. Over 5f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> (f<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> is the center frequency of the passband) common mode suppression can be realized by the bandstop performance of the coupled lines and stubs. A balanced filter with 3-dB bandwidth of 23.8% is designed and measured. Good agreement can be found between the theoretical and measured results.

articleTitle: The application of Fourier split-step parabolic equation method in the point-to-point communication
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: The mobile operators often use point-to-point microwave connections for feeder links in their access networks. However, the estimation of the propagating field of electromagnetic wave which is mainly solved along the propagating-link, but is less trend to solved by point-to-point in engineering application. The main reason is that wave propagation at the applied frequencies is highly influenced by participation, especially by environment conditions. But, when we estimate the propagating field along the propagation link, it will cost large amount of calculation. For the purpose of improving the computational efficiency and obtaining higher accuracy of point-to-point field value, this paper studies the application of the Fourier split-step parabolic equation (FSSPE) method in the point-to-point communication, analyzes the accuracy of this method calculated by two steps or three steps from the transmitting antenna to the receiving point, and compares the result with the result of the Rec. ITU-R P.526-13 and the experimental measuring results to verify the correctness. Usually, FSSPE is solved by marching over range steps. This paper uses the two-dimensional FSSPE and compares with just utilizing two steps or three steps to predict the propagation loss at the range whose propagation path encounters one or two obstacle neglecting thickness. The result shows that increasing significantly the computing interval doesn't decrease accuracy within the allowed error using the FSSPE, which is conducive to the further study of point-to-point communication. And then, it's proved that the parabolic equation not only has higher precision, but also has the advantage of less computation, which is beneficial to the development of corresponding software.

articleTitle: Research on variable rate PCM/FM telemetry modulation and demodulation technology
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: PCM/FM is a kind of system used in telemetry. In order to meet the needs of the future high-speed telemetry program, this paper studies the design of the 10K to 10M rate universal telemetry system. As the digital technology is more stable and flexible than the analog technology, this paper uses the full digital frequency synthesis technology to achieve PCM/FM modulation. In the digital implementation of PCM/FM modulation and demodulation, the software algorithm uses MATLAB language to simulate and verify, and combined with the hardware debugging results to prove that the system meets the requirements.

articleTitle: Spectral compressed sensing of real spikes
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper studies the reconstruction of a stream of real spikes, which has usually been studied in the context of finite rate of innovation (FRI), from compressive Fourier measurements. Two gridless sparse methods are proposed based on atomic norm and Toeplitz matrix completion, respectively, which are more precise results of and enjoy theoretical guarantees of their existing counterparts for line spectral estimation. Our analysis shows that atomic norm can better preserve signal structures and produce easy-to-interpret results. Numerical simulations suggest that Toeplitz matrix completion has higher resolution. The obtained results also shed light on the case of line spectral estimation.

articleTitle: Study on reliability growth of space borne SAR T/R module
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: Aiming at the disparity of reliability and lifetime between China made space borne SAR T/R module and overseas advanced product, reliability growth necessity is discussed in this paper. Procedure of reliability growth study, several important experiments, and difficulties encountered in the experiments along with solutions are introduced. Experiment results of this reliability growth study are revealed as follow: design lifetime of space borne SAR T/R module is improved evidently, simultaneously reliability of T/R module at the end of rated lifetime is expected higher than before, the cycle and funds of developing a new type of T/R module will be decreased greatly, etc.

articleTitle: Research on the quick acquisition of high dynamic spread spectrum signal
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: The speed of vehicles has been making too many breakthroughs, even 20 times of the speed of sound has been achieved. When using high communicating frequencies, it has huge difficulty to acquire spread spectrum (SS) signals with high Doppler shifts for a receiver. This article studied a time domain parallel acquisition method based on FFT, carrier tracking method for PLL-ring with FLL-ring, getting a full set of signal receiving scheme. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the algorithm in this article can complete acquisition.

articleTitle: A comb-like microstrip patch antenna with low cross polarization
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: In this paper, a simple method for reducing the cross polarization level of microstrip patch antenna is presented. The comb-like slots are utilized in the traditional microstrip patch antenna to improve the performance. With this method, the cross polarization level of patch antenna can be suppressed obviously, while the bandwidth will not be affected. The effectiveness of this method is verified by simulations.

articleTitle: Low-complexity downlink MMSE beamforming in massive MIMO systems
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: Massive MIMO (multiple-input-multiple-output) has been identified as a key technology to improve the cellular system throughput by several orders of magnitude. One practical concern of the implementation of massive MIMO lies in the high computational complexity for coherent and joint signal processing over a large number of antennas. To address this issue, we propose a low-complexity fixed-point algorithm to solve the downlink MMSE beamforming problem in massive MIMO systems. Specifically, the proposed algorithm has a linear complexity in the transmit antenna number, rendering it scalable in large systems. Through both analysis and numerical simulations, we show that the proposed algorithm has much lower complexity than the widely adopted existing algorithms, such as the interior point method and gradient descent method.

articleTitle: A variable gain amplifier based on dual gain control technology for ultra-wideband applications
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: In this paper, a dual gain control (DGC) technology is proposed to achieve large gain variation range and good gain flatness for every controllable gain in ultra wide frequency band. The DGC technology includes a modified current mirror structure and a dynamic signal feedback structure. Based on the DGC technology, a variable gain amplifier with both large dynamic gain variable range and good gain flatness in the ultrawideband of 3.1~10.6 GHz are realized.

articleTitle: A NLOS error suppression algorithm based on elastic enclosing circle
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: In order to improve the localization accuracy in non-line-of-sight (NLOS) environment, an elastic enclosing Circle is used in NLOS error suppression algorithm to identify the NLOS-Anchors with larger disturbance, and then the unknown node can be localized with the rest anchors. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has higher localization accuracy in comparison with the Residual weighting algorithm (Rwgh) and Maximum Likelihood algorithm (ML).

articleTitle: A UWB filter with tunable notch using microstrip/slotline structure with T-slot stub
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: This paper presents design of wide-band bandpass filter with tunable notch response for wireless communication system. The transmission line model is composed of two sets of series open-ended and short-ended stubs that are connected through transmission line, then a short-circuited stub is added. Based on transmission line model, a T-slot stub with microstrip/slotline structure is used to design this filter. Notch frequency can tuned from 4 GHz to 9 GHz by varying the length of T-slot stub. The center frequency is fixed at 6.75 GHz and has absolute bandwidth 8.3 GHz. The band has more than 30 dB rejection in simulation.

articleTitle: Study on plasma reconfigurable antenna array prototype
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: Plasma antenna is a sort of ionized gaseous antenna, which can be reconfigurable by altering the input RF power. This article introduces the reconfigurable plasma antenna and antenna array prototype of the NSSC. Through HFSS simulation, we studied the frequency reconfigurable, EMC and antenna array performance of plasma antenna. According to this study, plasma antenna has very wide bandwidth, its insulating medium gas cavity has very low EMI/RCS, and it is very suitable to be used in antenna array, low RCS antenna and ultra-wide/frequency hopping communication.

articleTitle: A broadband antenna at 11GHz based on quasi-Yagi antenna
publicationTitle: 2016 IEEE International Conference on Ubiquitous Wireless Broadband (ICUWB)
abstract: Design of a broadband antenna at 11GHz based on quasi-Yagi antenna is presented. The proposed antenna has dipole driver, U-shaped ground reflector and director.
